function: CSI compression at the UE and reconstruction at the BS for FDD massive MIMO feedback, using learned manifold landmark dictionaries and local-linear mapping (p. 3, p. 7-8).
system: Single-cell FDD massive MIMO-OFDM, BS ULA with 32 or 64 antennas, single-antenna UE, 48 RBs; 3GPP CDL-A at 3.5 GHz downlink; no RIS (p. 3, p. 8).
method: Unsupervised manifold learning: landmark dictionaries learned offline from historical CSI by alternating optimization; kNN local-linear weights then compress and reconstruct new CSI without iterations (p. 5, p. 7-8).
data_channel: 3GPP TR 38.901 CDL-A simulated in MATLAB (NR Release 16); dictionaries use N=4000 CSI samples; benchmarks train/validate/test on 100,000/30,000/20,000 samples (p. 8, p. 9).
test_conditions: Same CDL-A scenario for training and testing, common held-out test set; trained on perfect CSI, tested with channel-estimation SNR 5-30 dB; Nt=32 and Nt=64 evaluated (p. 8-10).
baselines: Learned: CLNet, NR-CsiNet, FISTA-Net. Non-learned: none; only the Perfect CSI upper bound and an ablation with random landmarks (p. 9, p. 10).
metrics: NMSE (dB), cosine similarity, spectral efficiency with eigen zero-forcing, trainable parameters, FLOPs (p. 8-11).
complexity: Time complexity: compression O(2Nf Nt k^2)+O(dMNt); reconstruction O(Nt k^3)+O(dNt k^2)+O(2Nf M Nt); 81.6K-96K parameters, 23.7-26.9 MFLOPs (p. 8, p. 9).
q1_support: p. 8: "under the industrial CDL channel model, conforming to 3GPP TR 38.901 [32]"; Table I on p. 8 lists CDL-A, and the training and testing sets are generated from it.
q2_support: p. 9: "The training data set, validation data set, and testing data set contain 100,000, 30,000, and 20,000 samples respectively" (held-out part of the same CDL-A data). p. 10: "they are all acquired through training with perfect CSI", then tested only over an estimation-SNR sweep; no new scenario, band, speed or dataset.
q3_support: p. 9: "Three DL-based algorithms (CLNet [40], NR-CsiNet [41], FISTA-Net [42]) are introduced as benchmarks", all learned. The only non-learned items are the ideal reference of p. 10, "the BS has perfect downlink CSI" (an upper bound), and p. 9: "we show the case of randomly chosen landmarks" (ablation); no classical CSI feedback method is compared.
q4_support: p. 8: "Hence, the total complexity of dimensionality reduction is O(2Nf Nt k 2 ) + O(dM Nt )"; Table II on p. 9 gives trainable parameters (81.6K at gamma = 1/16) and FLOPs (23.706M).
q5_support: p. 8: "With the help of MATLAB, we carry on the simulation for the 5G new radio (NR) Release 16 and generate the training and testing data sets [39]". Self-generated data; the paper gives no code or data link and uses no public or measured dataset.
notes: Included as learned: the dictionaries are manifold-learning parameters trained offline on a CSI set, and the paper itself lists them as trainable parameters (Table II, p. 9); inference is kNN plus closed-form weights, so the reviewer may confirm that this counts as learning. Area 2 (CSI feedback). q3 is 0 because the paper has no non-learned competing method; Perfect CSI is only an upper bound and the random-landmark case is an ablation of the proposed method.
